intent: A candlelit gown of the ancient Grashan court: a gold bodice with a stepped wine corset front and gold V neckline, a flame-crowned wine coif trailing pale gold veils, and tiers of wine ruffles belling wide to a gold hem rotted black at one edge; from the high camera it reads as a gold crown and corset over a broad wine bell, with three candle-gems burning.
reason: Wine-and-gold feast queen: a wine bell skirt flaring from the hip, a gold butterfly bodice and a candle crown, the richest and most epic read from the high camera and apart from every other family (second critic 6.85, first; first critic 6.08, second).
first_fix: The full-width wine sleeves make the top a broad slab: slim them with gold cuffs, round the hem, and let shade-black creep up the front.
